key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.45s): Initial archival pose of lipstick; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.58s): Mid-sequence articulation of lipstick; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.81s): Peak dynamic extension of lipstick over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=6.05s): Follow-through and settle of lipstick with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of lipstick (2.45s..6.05s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
